description:
Operate on the quick-capture queue at buffer.md: capture entries, regroup, validate, and flush them into per-thread daily logs.

Top-level flag: --quiet suppresses info output.

Subcommands:
  add TEXT — append an UNKNOWN entry (raw capture; blocks tend and flush until converted).
  suggest TEXT [-y] — propose a structured add-* for raw text, prompting to accept (INTERACTIVE unless -y).
  add-text THREAD TEXT — append a TEXT entry.
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date YYYY-MM-DD] — append a REF entry.
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — append an ACTION entry; also reachable as `tasks add`.
  list [FILTER] — show the buffer with line numbers.
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove a single line by its line number.
  tend — regroup entries by (thread, date) and validate; idempotent.
  flush — tend, then write entries to logs/ and clear the buffer.

Flags:
  suggest: -y auto-accepts the suggestion without prompting.
  add-ref: TARGET is a wikilink target — notes/<stem>, logs/<path>, people/<name>, hours/<Kind>/<Thread>, payments/<Kind>/<Thread>, or <Kind>/<Thread>. --date files the entry under that day instead of today; use the date the thing happened.
  add-action: --due YYYY-MM-DD, applied on flush and ingest; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-hex-char uuid prefix, repeatable for multiple dependencies.

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Validated the SQL detection patterns; join semantics still unresolved"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send the quarterly report", "--due", "2026-09-30", "--priority", "H"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00", "Vendor decision", "--date", "2026-09-10"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never call `suggest` without -y; it prompts on stdin.
  Prefer the structured add-text / add-ref / add-action over `add`. An UNKNOWN entry from `add` is intentionally invalid: `tend` reports it as a violation and it blocks `flush` until removed with `rm` and re-added via the matching add-* command.
  `flush` rewrites buffer.md, emptying it, and appends to logs/. Run `list` and `tend` first to check what will be written.
  Line numbers from `list` shift after any `rm`, `tend` or `flush`; re-run `list` before each `rm`.
  THREAD must resolve to an existing thread file under threads/<Kind>/<Name>.md.
  ACTION entries become TASK anchors only after `flush` writes them to a log and `tasks` is then run with no subcommand.
  Do not edit buffer.md directly; use these subcommands and `tend`.
  Exit code 1 on empty text or description, a --date or --due that is not YYYY-MM-DD, or a --depends value that is not 8 hex characters.
